programs.title: SBS World News

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.desc: The Titanic's tragic story captures the imagination of the public and experts of all kinds, who, decades after the ship's demise, still seek answers. A look into new evidence that might reveal more about how and why the Titanic sank.

programs.title: Bettany Hughes' Lost Worlds: Nabataeans
programs.desc: In the final leg of her journey into the hidden world of the Nabataeans, Bettany arrives in Petra, their capital and she delves into the city at its peak, marvelling at its sophistication and wealth.

programs.title: Tulum: The Last City Of The Mayan Empire
programs.desc: Renowned for their skills and knowledge in fields as varied as astronomy, mathematics, agriculture and art in all its forms, the Maya people disappeared, taking many of their secrets with them.

programs.title: The Kim Dynasty: A Family Affair
programs.desc: In the geopolitics of our time, North Korea takes centre stage. With the help of leading experts, including former Pyongyang regime officials, this film seeks to uncover North Korea's ultimate plan.

programs.title: Duran Duran: A Hollywood High
programs.desc: A show-stopping, feature-length docu-concert, with exclusive new interviews, behind-the-scenes video and unseen archival footage, A Hollywood High celebrates Duran Duran's four-decade-long career, charting their rise to become one of the most influential and successful bands of all time.
